services.name: Sailfish/Mahi Special Charter | 10 Hours
services.desc: For those unfamiliar with Swordfish, they are not to be confused with Sailfish, another great but very different game fish available to anglers here in South Florida. Sailfish are most often encountered at a fraction of the distance from shore than Swordfish. Swordfish are a totally different species than Sailfish and specialty charters for Swordfish are for full days

explain.meaning: The whole boat is booked for your group alone.

includes: Safety equipment above Coast Guard requirements
blurb: Guests fish for species like Sailfish, Dolphin, Tuna, Snapper, and Tilefish near Fort Lauderdale or in the Bahamas. Trips range from 3 to 8 hours on a 46 ft or 53 ft Hatteras sportfisherman with experienced captains and full amenities. Family-friendly charters encourage kids to fish and enjoy the experience.
extraNote: If weather is bad the captain will make the final decision if the weather is too bad to go fishing. · No black-out dates for gift certificates
